answer: Identities funded from a common source within 21 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the forge graph is rebuilt each epoch, the lagoon merge is applied at settlement and the ridge audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 6 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
